title: It Ends with Us
author: Colleen Hoover
description: Having grown up witnessing domestic strife, Lily Bloom builds a new life in Boston and starts her own floral boutique. She enters an intense relationship with Ryle Kincaid, a brilliant neurosurgeon whose volatile tendencies gradually echo patterns from her childhood. When her first love Atlas Corrigan reappears, Lily is forced to make a harrowing choice to break cycles of abuse.

title: It Starts with Us
author: Colleen Hoover
description: Following her divorce from Ryle, Lily navigates a delicate co-parenting dynamic while striving to rebuild emotional equilibrium. When Atlas asks her out on a formal date, their rekindled romance promises a healthy chapter of mutual respect. However, navigating Ryle's lingering jealousy and presence challenges their pursuit of lasting happiness.

title: Ugly Love
author: Colleen Hoover
description: Nursing student Tate Collins moves into her brother's apartment and meets his friend Miles Archer, an airline pilot harboring emotional trauma. Agreeing to a physical arrangement with two rules—never ask about the past and expect no future—they attempt to stay unattached. As unspoken feelings develop, the pain of Miles's history threatens to unravel their connection.

title: Reminders of Him
author: Colleen Hoover
description: After serving five years in prison for a tragic vehicular accident that killed the love of her life, Kenna Rowan returns to her hometown to reunite with her young daughter. Met with hostility from her late partner's family, she finds an unexpected ally in Ledger Ward, a local bar owner who shares ties to her child. As their relationship grows, Kenna fights for redemption and a second chance at motherhood.

title: November 9
author: Colleen Hoover
description: Fallon and aspiring novelist Ben meet by chance in Los Angeles on the eve of her cross-country relocation. Deeply drawn to one another, they make a pact to reunite on the exact same date every year without digital communication in between. Over several annual encounters, Ben turns their meetings into the premise of his book until a hidden truth jeopardizes their trust.

title: Heart Bones
author: Colleen Hoover
description: Beyah Grim grows up in poverty, relying on self-discipline and athletic scholarships to secure a route out of her upbringing. When an unexpected tragedy leaves her homeless right before college, she spends the summer on a Texas peninsula with her estranged father. There she connects with Samson, a wealthy neighbor whose quiet sadness mirrors her own hidden wounds.

title: Outlander
author: Diana Gabaldon
description: While vacationing in the Scottish Highlands in 1945, former British combat nurse Claire Randall walks through a circle of standing stones and is transported to 1743. Thrust into clan conflicts, she is forced into marriage with Jamie Fraser, an honorable Highland warrior. Claire finds herself torn between two eras, cultures, and loyalties across history.

title: Dragonfly in Amber
author: Diana Gabaldon
description: Having traveled to 18th-century Paris, Claire and Jamie Fraser infiltrate the French aristocracy to subvert the doomed Jacobite rebellion. They navigate espionage, shifting alliances, and court intrigues while trying to preserve their marriage. Decades later in 1968, Claire reveals the truth of her past to her daughter Brianna.

title: Voyager
author: Diana Gabaldon
description: Twenty years after returning to the 20th century believing Jamie died at Culloden, Claire uncovers historical proof that he survived the battle. Aided by her daughter and historian Roger Wakefield, Claire chooses to step through the stones once again. Their reunion takes them across the high seas to the West Indies to rescue an abducted family member.

title: Me Before You
author: Jojo Moyes
description: Louisa Clark, a quirky woman from a working-class town, takes a position as a caretaker for Will Traynor, a wealthy former banker paralyzed in a motorcycle accident. Will has grown cynical and despondent, quietly planning to end his life at an assisted suicide clinic. As Lou attempts to show him reasons to live, the two form an unexpected bond that transforms both of their worldviews.

title: After You
author: Jojo Moyes
description: Struggling to move forward after Will's passing, Louisa Clark works at an airport bar in London, feeling isolated and adrift. An accidental fall from her roof pushes her into a grief support group, where she meets paramedic Sam Fielding. Her path shifts further when a rebellious teenager with unexpected ties to Will appears on her doorstep.

title: Red, White & Royal Blue
author: Casey McQuiston
description: When an altercation between Alex Claremont-Diaz, the First Son of the United States, and Britain's Prince Henry leaks to tabloids, an international incident looms. To manage diplomatic fallout, both governments orchestrate a staged friendship and public media campaign. Behind closed doors, their animosity turns into a covert romance that risks upending a presidential election.

title: One Last Stop
author: Casey McQuiston
description: Cynical twenty-three-year-old August moves to New York City seeking anonymity and distance from her family. While commuting, she becomes infatuated with Jane, a charismatic punk woman riding the Q subway line. August soon discovers Jane is displaced in time from the 1970s, prompting an investigation across decades to help return her home.

title: The Hating Game
author: Sally Thorne
description: Executive assistants Lucy Hutton and Joshua Templeman sit opposite each other in mutual animosity after their publishing houses merge. Locked in passive-aggressive mind games, their workplace hostility peaks when they are pitted against each other for a major promotion. After an unexpected elevator kiss, Lucy must decipher whether Joshua is playing a ruthless corporate gambit or harboring genuine feelings.

title: The Spanish Love Deception
author: Elena Armas
description: Catalina Martín needs a date for her sister's wedding in Spain after fabricating an American boyfriend to save face. Desperate for a solution, she accepts an offer from Aaron Blackford, her aloof, condescending workplace rival. As they travel abroad together, Catalina discovers that Aaron's true character differs from his professional demeanor.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: In 19th-century rural England, headstrong Elizabeth Bennet faces mounting pressure from her family to secure a financially advantageous marriage. When the wealthy and enigmatic Mr. Darcy arrives in her social sphere, their mutual pride and initial misconceptions ignite an antagonistic dynamic. Over time, a series of family crises and personal revelations force Elizabeth and Darcy to confront their underlying prejudices and acknowledge their profound bond.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
description: Orphaned as a child and subjected to cruelty at Lowood School, Jane Eyre takes on employment as a governess at the secluded Thornfield Hall. She develops an intense intellectual and emotional connection with her brooding employer, Edward Rochester. When an ominous secret concealed within the manor threatens their prospective union, Jane must weigh moral autonomy against her devotion.

title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
description: Set against the windswept Yorkshire moors, this Gothic romance chronicles the turbulent attachment between Heathcliff and Catherine Earnshaw. Social hierarchies and personal ambition drive Catherine to wed another man, triggering Heathcliff's lifelong quest for vindictive retribution. Their destructive passion reverberates through the lives of the succeeding generation.

title: Sense and Sensibility
author: Jane Austen
description: Following their father's death, the Dashwood sisters face sudden financial instability and social displacement. Sensible Elinor conceals her heartbreak over Edward Ferrars, while romantic Marianne openly surrenders to her attraction to the dashing Willoughby. Both sisters navigate deception, societal expectations, and emotional adversity to discover genuine companionship.

title: Emma
author: Jane Austen
description: Clever, wealthy, and self-assured, Emma Woodhouse fancies herself an unrivaled matchmaker among her neighbors in Highbury. Her well-meaning interference frequently leads to romantic confusion, misinterpretations, and unintended hurt. As her schemes unravel, Emma must acknowledge her flaws and confront her unspoken feelings for George Knightley.

title: Persuasion
author: Jane Austen
description: Eight years after being persuaded by her family to break her engagement to Captain Frederick Wentworth, Anne Elliot leads a quiet, overlooked life. When Wentworth returns as a wealthy naval officer, the pair are thrust back into the same social circles with unresolved feelings. Amid changing fortunes, Anne and Wentworth must determine whether second chances can overcome pride and the passage of time.

title: Northanger Abbey
author: Jane Austen
description: Naive, seventeen-year-old Catherine Morland leaves her quiet home to experience the bustling social scene of Bath, fueled by her fascination with Gothic fiction. When she is invited to the mysterious ancestral estate of Northanger Abbey, her active imagination leads her to suspect dark, melodramatic secrets. Guided by the witty Henry Tilney, Catherine learns to balance fanciful literature with practical reality.

title: The Notebook
author: Nicholas Sparks
description: In a modern nursing facility, an elderly man faithfully reads a handwritten notebook to a fellow resident slipping into dementia. The story recounts the 1940s summer romance between working-class Noah Calhoun and privileged Allie Nelson, severed by social barriers and war. Decades later, their enduring devotion is tested by memory loss, honoring a commitment that defies physical and mental decline.

title: A Walk to Remember
author: Nicholas Sparks
description: In late 1950s North Carolina, Landon Carter is a rebellious high school senior coasting through life without direction. When forced to participate in the annual school play, he turns to Jamie Sullivan, the minister's quiet daughter whom he once ridiculed, for guidance. As genuine affection develops between them, Jamie discloses a terminal secret that forces Landon to discover empathy and purpose.

title: Dear John
author: Nicholas Sparks
description: During a brief leave from the military, John Tyree falls in love with Savannah Curtis, a college student dedicated to volunteer work. When global events lead John to reenlist, their relationship is maintained through handwritten letters spanning overseas deployments. As the separation stretches across years, unexpected life circumstances test whether their bond can withstand duty and sacrifice.

title: The Lucky One
author: Nicholas Sparks
description: While serving as a Marine in Iraq, Logan Thibault finds a discarded photograph of an unknown smiling woman that inexplicably keeps him safe through combat. Convinced the talisman saved his life, Logan walks across the country to North Carolina to locate her. He secures work at her family dog kennel, developing an attachment while keeping the origin of his journey hidden.

title: Safe Haven
author: Nicholas Sparks
description: A guarded young woman named Katie arrives in the small coastal town of Southport, determined to keep her past concealed. Despite her reservations, she forms connections with a widowed store owner and his children, gradually finding solace in their community. However, her former life and a pursuing threat close in, forcing her to confront her fears.

title: The Last Song
author: Nicholas Sparks
description: Seventeen-year-old Ronnie Miller is resentful when her mother sends her to spend the summer with her estranged musician father in a quiet beach town. Passionate about classical piano yet refusing to play, Ronnie gradually finds common ground with her father through a shared affinity for music. Her summer takes an unexpected turn when she falls for a local volleyball player, helping her heal family rifts.

title: Message in a Bottle
author: Nicholas Sparks
description: While jogging on a deserted beach, divorced journalist Theresa Osborne discovers a poignant, bottled letter addressed to a lost love named Catherine. Touched by the raw grief in the writing, Theresa launches a search that leads her to Garrett Blake, a widowed North Carolina boatbuilder. As their connection deepens, Garrett struggles to let go of past sorrow to embrace a new future.

title: The American Roommate Experiment
author: Elena Armas
description: Rosie Graham quits her corporate career to focus on writing romance novels, only to face severe creative block and apartment repairs. She takes temporary refuge in her best friend's studio, unaware that Lucas Martín has also been offered the space. Lucas proposes an experimental dating project to spark her inspiration, testing the boundary between fiction and real emotion.

title: Beach Read
author: Emily Henry
description: January Andrews, a romance writer grieving her father and battling creative block, rents a lakeside cottage in Michigan for the summer. She discovers that her next-door neighbor is Augustus Everett, an acclaimed literary novelist from her college past. Trapped in mutual writing slumps, they strike a bet to swap genres, leading to shared research trips that challenge their outlooks on love.

title: People We Meet on Vacation
author: Emily Henry
description: Poppy and Alex have been unlikely best friends since college, taking an annual week-long summer trip together despite contrasting lifestyles. Two years after an incident ruined their routine and created distance between them, Poppy convinces Alex to take one final trip to Palm Springs. Over the course of the getaway, they confront their unresolved feelings and the realities of their friendship.

title: Book Lovers
author: Emily Henry
description: Nora Stephens is a cutthroat literary agent in Manhattan who consistently gets passed over in favor of small-town sweethearts. When her pregnant sister convinces her to spend a month in Sunshine Falls, North Carolina, Nora keeps running into Charlie Lastra, a hypercritical editor from her past. Away from corporate life, they explore their vulnerabilities and reconsider the expectations placed upon them.

title: Happy Place
author: Emily Henry
description: Harriet and Wyn were considered the perfect college couple, but quietly broke off their engagement months ago without telling their friend group. When the group gathers for their annual week-long vacation at a Maine cottage, Harriet and Wyn agree to pretend they are still together to avoid disrupting the tradition. Confined to close quarters, they confront the emotional disconnect that drove them apart.

title: The Love Hypothesis
author: Ali Hazelwood
description: Stanford biology Ph.D. candidate Olive Smith impulsively kisses the first man she sees in a laboratory hallway to convince her best friend she is happily dating. That man turns out to be Adam Carlsen, a notoriously demanding and aloof young professor. Adam agrees to continue the fake relationship to protect his research funding, leading to collaborative breakthroughs and genuine romantic tension.

title: Love on the Brain
author: Ali Hazelwood
description: Neuroengineer Bee Königswasser lands a career-defining project leading an engineering team at NASA for neuro-helmets. Her excitement falters when she learns she is co-leading the initiative with Levi Ward, her distant graduate school rival. When equipment sabotage threatens the assignment, Bee discovers Levi is an unexpectedly steadfast partner in and out of the lab.

title: Love, Theoretically
author: Ali Hazelwood
description: Elsie Hannaway is an underpaid adjunct professor of theoretical physics who supplements her income by working as a professional fake date for clients. When applying for a tenured faculty position at MIT, she finds that the hiring committee chair is Jack Smith, the older brother of a favorite client. Elsie must navigate academic politics and maintain her professional standing alongside Jack.

title: The Duke and I
author: Julia Quinn
description: In Regency London, Daphne Bridgerton seeks a love match but struggles under the protective oversight of her older brother Anthony. Simon Basset, the Duke of Hastings, is determined to avoid the marriage mart after a vow made against his abusive late father. The pair form a pact to stage a mock courtship to elevate Daphne's prospects and shield Simon from ambitious mamas, but their pretense soon gives way to authentic passion.

title: The Viscount Who Loved Me
author: Julia Quinn
description: Anthony Bridgerton decides to fulfill his duty by marrying an agreeable, sensible bride without emotional attachment. He sets his sights on society's incomparable Edwina Sheffield, but must first secure the blessing of her protective older sister Kate. As Kate and Anthony engage in verbal sparring, they realize their shared intensity hides mutual attraction.

title: An Offer From a Gentleman
author: Julia Quinn
description: Sophie Beckett is reduced to a domestic servant by her callous stepmother after the death of her aristocratic father. Sneaking into the Bridgerton masquerade ball, she shares a dance with Benedict Bridgerton before vanishing into the night. Years later, Benedict rescues a maid in distress, unaware she is the masked woman he has spent seasons searching for.

title: Romancing Mister Bridgerton
author: Julia Quinn
description: Penelope Featherington has harbored an unrequited devotion to Colin Bridgerton while writing society commentary under the pseudonym Lady Whistledown. When Colin returns from abroad, he begins seeing Penelope through an altered lens of respect and desire. As a high-stakes bounty threatens to expose her secret identity, their bond is tested by trust and pride.

title: To Sir Phillip, With Love
author: Julia Quinn
description: Following the death of her distant cousin, Eloise Bridgerton initiates a correspondence with the grieving widower, Sir Phillip Crane. Assuming Eloise is an agreeable spinster in need of a home, Phillip extends a marriage proposal sight unseen. When Eloise impulsively arrives at his rural estate, they discover that domestic realities require compromise and understanding.

title: When He Was Wicked
author: Julia Quinn
description: Michael Stirling, London's most notorious rake, falls in love with Francesca Bridgerton just days before she marries his beloved cousin John. For years, Michael keeps his devotion hidden, maintaining a position as a faithful family confidant. When tragedy leaves Francesca a widow, Michael inherits the earldom and must navigate his guilt and desire as they confront their mutual grief.

title: The Time Traveler's Wife
author: Audrey Niffenegger
description: Henry DeTamble suffers from a rare genetic disorder that causes him to involuntarily travel through time, appearing at various points in his past and future. Clare Abshire meets him as a child and spends years waiting for his timeline to align with her present. Their marriage endures absences, emotional strain, and foreknowledge of their fate.

title: One Day
author: David Nicholls
description: Dexter Mayhew and Emma Morley spend the night together following their university graduation on July 15, 1988, establishing a complex connection. The narrative checks in on them on that exact calendar date across two decades of personal successes, missed chances, and professional struggles. Their relationship mirrors the evolution of adulthood and the enduring impact of a single bond.

title: The Fault in Our Stars
author: John Green
description: Sixteen-year-old Hazel Grace Lancaster lives with terminal thyroid cancer and attends a youth support group under her parents' urging. There she meets Augustus Waters, an amputee in remission whose wit challenges her defensive worldview. Together, they embark on a journey to Amsterdam to meet a reclusive author, finding meaning in the time they have.

title: Twilight
author: Stephenie Meyer
description: Bella Swan relocates to the rainy Pacific Northwest town of Forks to live with her father, expecting a quiet transition. She is drawn to Edward Cullen, an enigmatic classmate who harbors a secret: he is an immortal vampire struggling against predatory instincts. Their growing attachment draws the attention of rival vampire trackers, putting Bella in danger.

title: New Moon
author: Stephenie Meyer
description: Devastated by Edward's abrupt decision to leave Forks to ensure her safety, Bella falls into a profound emotional depression. She finds solace and support in her growing bond with Jacob Black, a member of the Quileute tribe who experiences a supernatural transformation of his own. When a misunderstanding leads Edward to believe Bella has died, she races across Europe to save his life.

title: Eclipse
author: Stephenie Meyer
description: Seattle is besieged by a string of violent murders orchestrated by an army of newborn vampires seeking vengeance against Bella. Forced to unite to protect her, the Cullen family and the Quileute shapeshifters forge a temporary alliance. Amid the looming battle, Bella is forced to choose between her commitment to Edward and her bond with Jacob.

title: Breaking Dawn
author: Stephenie Meyer
description: Bella and Edward marry and embark on their honeymoon, but an unprecedented pregnancy threatens Bella's health. The birth of their child introduces a hybrid life that draws the scrutiny of the Volturi, the ruling vampire coven in Italy. Facing execution, the Cullens summon global allies to bear witness and defend their family.

title: Fifty Shades of Grey
author: E.L. James
description: College literature student Anastasia Steele steps in to interview wealthy entrepreneur Christian Grey for her campus paper. Christian pursues Anastasia, introducing her to an unconventional romantic lifestyle governed by formal contracts. As their relationship unfolds, Anastasia must navigate Christian's need for control while confronting his past emotional wounds.

title: Beautiful Disaster
author: Jamie McGuire
description: College freshman Abby Abernathy attempts to distance herself from a troubled past and maintain the facade of a studious student. She crosses paths with Travis Maddox, a tattooed underground fighter and campus ladies' man intrigued by her resistance to his charms. A friendly wager forces them to room together for a month, blurring their boundaries and reigniting personal vulnerabilities.

title: Normal People
author: Sally Rooney
description: In a small Irish town, popular football player Connell and wealthy, isolated Marianne carry out a secret relationship. When they matriculate at Trinity College Dublin, their social dynamics invert: Marianne thrives in intellectual circles while Connell struggles with alienation. Over subsequent years, their shared bond endures across miscommunication and divergent life paths.

title: Conversations with Friends
author: Sally Rooney
description: Dublin college students Frances and Bobbi perform spoken-word poetry and catch the interest of Melissa, an older journalist. They are invited into Melissa's social circle, where Frances begins a clandestine, emotionally fraught affair with Melissa's actor husband, Nick. As boundaries blur, Frances is forced to confront vulnerabilities, chronic illness, and shifting artistic identity.

title: Call Me by Your Name
author: André Aciman
description: During the summer of 1983 on the Italian Riviera, seventeen-year-old intellectual Elio Perlman meets Oliver, an American scholar residing with Elio's family. What starts as casual detachment shifts into an intense romance framed by art, classical literature, and Mediterranean landscapes. The brief summer affair leaves an indelible emotional legacy that reverberates across their lives.

title: P.S. I Love You
author: Cecelia Ahern
description: Devastated by the death of her husband Gerry from an illness, thirty-year-old Holly Kennedy struggles to manage her grief in Dublin. She discovers a bundle of ten letters Gerry left behind, designed to guide her month by month through grief and personal rediscovery. Supported by family and Gerry's final messages, Holly navigates sorrow to build a new chapter.

title: Where Rainbows End
author: Cecelia Ahern
description: Told through letters, emails, and notes, this story follows Rosie Dunne and Alex Stewart, lifelong Dublin friends separated when Alex's family moves to Boston. Intended to reunite for college, unexpected life turns, early parenthood, and divergent marriages keep them apart. Over fifty years of missed timing, their enduring friendship challenges the choices that defined their lives.

title: The Unhoneymooners
author: Christina Lauren
description: Olive Torres considers herself chronically unlucky, while her twin sister Ami seems to skate through life effortlessly. When an entire wedding party falls ill with food poisoning except for Olive and the best man, Ethan, they take the bride's non-refundable luxury Hawaii honeymoon. Posing as newlyweds to keep the prize, two sworn enemies must manage mutual attraction.

title: Love and Other Words
author: Christina Lauren
description: Macy Sorensen leads an orderly life as a pediatric resident in San Francisco, engaged to a stable man she does not passionately love. When she runs into Elliot Petropoulos—her childhood friend and first love whom she hasn't seen in a decade—the memories of their shared past resurface. Unraveling the tragedy that caused their split, Macy must decide whether to risk her composure for genuine intimacy.

title: The Soulmate Equation
author: Christina Lauren
description: Single mother and statistician Jess Davis relies on hard numbers rather than faith to navigate life. When a DNA-based matchmaking agency asserts that she shares an unprecedented 98 percent genetic compatibility with the company's aloof founder, Dr. River Peña, she is skeptical. Offered a financial incentive to test the algorithm in public, Jess explores whether compatibility can be engineered.

title: Things We Never Got Over
author: Lucy Score
description: Runaway bride Naomi Witt arrives in rural Virginia to bail out her estranged twin sister, only to find herself robbed and left with a niece she never knew existed. Knox Morgan, a local barber who prefers isolation and routine, reluctantly intervenes to help Naomi secure housing and work. As they manage small-town gossip and danger from her sister's past, their opposites-attract dynamic deepens.

title: Things We Hide from the Light
author: Lucy Score
description: Police Chief Nash Morgan struggles with anxiety and recovery after surviving a gunshot wound during an investigation in Knockemout. His routine is upended by the arrival of Lina, an independent insurance investigator handling a sensitive case. Drawn to each other despite personal baggage, they must confront municipal crime and their respective emotional barriers.

title: The Flatshare
author: Beth O'Leary
description: Tiffy Moore needs an affordable London rental immediately following a breakup, while Leon Twomey needs extra income while working night shifts as a palliative hospice nurse. They agree to share a one-bedroom flat without meeting, occupying the space on opposite schedules and communicating via Post-it notes. As their notes grow more personal, an authentic relationship blossoms before they ever meet in person.

title: The Switch
author: Beth O'Leary
description: Burned out by corporate life in London after suffering a panic attack, Leena Cotton is ordered to take a two-month sabbatical. Meanwhile, her adventurous seventy-nine-year-old grandmother Eileen seeks a fresh start in love following her husband's departure. The two women swap lives: Leena manages a Yorkshire village while Eileen explores urban living, both discovering unexpected romance and community.

title: The Road Trip
author: Beth O'Leary
description: Addie and her sister are driving to a friend's wedding in rural Spain when an unexpected fender bender forces them to carpool with her former partner Dylan and his friend. Two years after a painful breakup, Addie and Dylan are trapped in a crowded car for hundreds of miles. Through alternating timelines, the narrative explores the history of their initial romance and the factors that led to its collapse.

title: Every Summer After
author: Carley Fortune
description: Persephone Fraser returns to the lakeside resort town of Barry's Bay for the funeral of a matriarch, confronting the memories of six teenage summers spent with Sam Florek. Once inseparable friends who grew into first loves, their connection shattered following an unspoken mistake years prior. Alternating between past memories and present reunions, Persephone and Sam confront whether they can forgive past missteps.

title: Meet Me at the Lake
author: Carley Fortune
description: Fern Brookbanks spent an unforgettable, romantic twenty-four hours in her early twenties with a charismatic artist named Will Baxter, who promised to meet her a year later but never appeared. A decade later, Fern is managing her late mother's lakeside resort when Will unexpectedly arrives as an operational consultant. Over a working summer, they confront missed opportunities and the burdens that kept them apart.

title: Twisted Love
author: Ana Huang
description: Alex Volkov is a ruthless investment prodigy consumed by a drive to avenge a childhood tragedy. When his best friend leaves the country, Alex agrees to look after and protect his friend's younger sister, photography student Ava Chen. Despite their clashing personalities, an intense attraction pulls them together, until buried secrets from their pasts threaten their relationship.

title: Twisted Games
author: Ana Huang
description: Rhys Larsen is a stoic, elite bodyguard who adheres to strict personal rules, chief among them avoiding emotional involvement with clients. He is assigned to protect Princess Bridget of Eldorra, whose rebellious independence challenges his authority. When an unexpected abdication places Bridget directly in line for the throne, their forbidden romance collides with centuries-old royal duty.

title: Twisted Hate
author: Ana Huang
description: Josh Chen is a charming medical resident who has engaged in a years-long rivalry with his sister's best friend, ambitious legal intern Jules Ambrose. Following a business dispute, they agree to an unattached enemies-with-benefits pact governed by strict boundaries. As the pretense fades, both must confront the personal traumas that fuel their defensive exteriors.

title: Twisted Lies
author: Ana Huang
description: Christian Harper is an elusive security billionaire whose polished demeanor conceals ruthless underworld ties. He develops a covert obsession with his tenant, social media influencer and author Stella Silva, orchestrating circumstances to act as her fake boyfriend for society events. As their staged relationship deepens, an external stalker threatens to expose Christian's web of secrets.

title: King of Wrath
author: Ana Huang
description: Dante Russo is an arrogant, calculating billionaire CEO who values control above all else. He is blackmailed into an arranged engagement with Vivian Lau, an elegant jewelry designer and daughter of an ambitious business rival. Despite their mutual resentment of the forced union, an unexpected attraction emerges as they navigate high-society expectations.

title: Yours Truly
author: Abby Jimenez
description: ER physician Dr. Briana Ortiz is enduring a messy divorce and competing for a promotion with the hospital's new transfer, Dr. Jacob Maddox. After an abrasive initial encounter, Jacob leaves a handwritten letter explaining his severe social anxiety, prompting an ongoing paper correspondence between their lockers. The letters foster mutual trust, leading to an arrangement that challenges Briana's defensive walls.

title: Part of Your World
author: Abby Jimenez
description: Alexis Montgomery is an accomplished emergency room doctor who belongs to an esteemed medical dynasty in Minneapolis. When her car gets stranded in a small rural town, she meets Daniel Grant, a laid-back carpenter and municipal mayor ten years her junior. Alexis finds herself caught between the demands of her elite family and the genuine community life Daniel represents.

title: The Friend Zone
author: Abby Jimenez
description: Kristen Petersen is planning her best friend's wedding while quietly preparing for a medically necessary hysterectomy to treat debilitating reproductive illness. She meets the groom's best man, Josh Copeland, who is handsome, emotionally intuitive, and dreams of having a large family. Convinced she cannot offer him the future he wants, Kristen attempts to keep Josh in the friend zone despite their connection.

title: The Happy Ever After Playlist
author: Abby Jimenez
description: Two years after losing her fiancé in an accident, Sloan Monroe's life is disrupted when a stray golden retriever jumps through her sunroof. After weeks of caring for the dog, she is contacted by its owner, Jason Thorn, an international rock musician touring abroad. Their phone conversations evolve into mutual affection, forcing Sloan to decide whether she is ready to risk her heart again.

title: Life's Too Short
author: Abby Jimenez
description: Vanessa Price lives in the moment as a successful globe-trotting travel vlogger, knowing she carries a genetic mutation that took the lives of her mother and sister. Her lifestyle pauses when she steps up to become the legal guardian of her infant niece. Adrian Copeland, a workaholic lawyer living next door, steps in to assist, sparking a romance that challenges Vanessa's fear of the future.

title: Evvie Drake Starts Over
author: Linda Holmes
description: In a coastal Maine town, Evvie Drake lives in isolation following the sudden death of her husband, harboring guilt over planning to leave him the day he died. Dean Tenney, a former Major League Baseball pitcher battling the sudden inability to throw, arrives in town looking for a refuge from sports media scrutiny. Renting the apartment behind her house, Dean and Evvie form an uncomplicated friendship based on shared healing.

title: Flying Solo
author: Linda Holmes
description: Following a canceled wedding, forty-year-old wildlife specialist Laurie Sascher returns to her Maine hometown to clear out the estate of her adventurous great-aunt. While sorting through belongings, Laurie discovers a valuable wooden duck decoy that is quickly stolen, launching her into an investigation alongside local friends and an old high school flame. The inquiry helps Laurie reconsider what a fulfilling independent life looks like.

title: Get a Life, Chloe Brown
author: Talia Hibbert
description: Chloe Brown is a fiercely independent web designer managing chronic pain and fibromyalgia who resolves to 'get a life' after a near-death encounter. She creates an action-oriented bucket list of rebellious pursuits, including riding a motorcycle and initiating a casual fling. She recruits Redford Morgan, her apartment building's handyman, to teach her how to take risks, sparking authentic intimacy.

title: Take a Hint, Dani Brown
author: Talia Hibbert
description: Academic Danika Brown focuses entirely on career milestones and academic research, avoiding serious relationships to protect her professional ambitions. When an unexpected elevator drill rescue with security guard Zafir Ansari goes viral online, the pair stage a fake public relationship to help promote Zafir's youth sports charity. As their staged affection blurs into authentic intimacy, Dani reevaluates her reluctance toward vulnerability.

title: Act Your Age, Eve Brown
author: Talia Hibbert
description: Eve Brown is a chaotic, free-spirited woman whose family demands she find steady employment and take accountability for her future. She accidentally drives her car into Jacob Wayne, the meticulous, autistic owner of a quaint bed-and-breakfast in the Cotswolds, breaking his arm. Feeling responsible, Eve steps in as his temporary chef, initiating a clash of habits that leads to mutual empathy.

title: Attachments
author: Rainbow Rowell
description: Set in 1999, Lincoln O'Neill works night shifts as an internet security officer at a newspaper, tasked with monitoring flagged staff emails. Instead of reporting colleagues Beth and Jennifer for their humorous, personal exchanges, Lincoln finds himself reading their daily messages and falling in love with Beth. As Y2K approaches, Lincoln struggles to find a way to meet her without confessing his monitoring role.

title: Eleanor & Park
author: Rainbow Rowell
description: Set over the course of a school year in 1986 Nebraska, this novel follows two sixteen-year-old outsiders who sit together on a daily bus ride. Eleanor, struggling with an abusive home life and peer bullying, finds understanding in Park, a quiet half-Korean boy who shares his comic books and punk rock cassette tapes. Their growing romance becomes a sanctuary against difficult domestic realities.

title: Fangirl
author: Rainbow Rowell
description: Cath Avery is an introverted college freshman whose comfort zone lies in writing widely read fan fiction for a popular fantasy series. While navigating separation from her twin sister and managing concerns about their father, Cath struggles to adapt to dorm living and creative writing courses. Aided by her roommate and an encouraging classmate, Cath steps outward toward independence and first love.

title: The Kiss Quotient
author: Helen Hoang
description: Stella Lane is a successful econometrician with Asperger's who struggles with romantic interaction and sensory sensitivities. Determined to gain confidence in dating, she hires professional escort Michael Phan to provide instruction and companionship. Michael's patience and care help Stella explore emotional vulnerability, transforming their business arrangement into genuine devotion.

title: The Bride Test
author: Helen Hoang
description: Khai Diep is an autistic accountant who believes he lacks the capacity to feel complex emotions, choosing to avoid romantic pursuits. His mother travels to Vietnam and recruits My, a young single mother working in a salon, arranging for her to spend a summer in California to win his heart. As My and Khai spend time together, Khai realizes that love can express itself through devotion rather than conventional behavior.

title: The Heart Principle
author: Helen Hoang
description: Burned-out violinist Anna Sun experiences a creative block just as a performance video goes viral. When her long-term boyfriend suggests an open relationship before marriage, Anna embarks on a series of casual encounters to reclaim autonomy, meeting motorcycle enthusiast Quan Diep. As family health crises and a late autism diagnosis unfold, Quan provides an understanding space for Anna's recovery.

title: From Lukov with Love
author: Mariana Zapata
description: Figure skater Jasmine Santos faces the end of her competitive athletic career after losing her partner and enduring a string of injuries. She receives an unexpected proposition from Ivan Lukov, an arrogant Olympic champion looking for a temporary pairs partner. Putting aside years of mutual animosity, Jasmine and Ivan begin demanding training sessions that yield genuine mutual respect.

title: The Wall of Winnipeg and Me
author: Mariana Zapata
description: Vanessa Mazur resigns from her position as an executive assistant and cook for Aiden Graves, the NFL's premier defensive end who barely acknowledged her presence for two years. Aiden arrives at her doorstep to ask her to return under a contractual marriage of convenience to help him secure Canadian citizenship. Living together as partners, Vanessa discovers the discipline and vulnerability behind Aiden's guarded exterior.

title: Kulti
author: Mariana Zapata
description: Professional women's soccer player Sal Casillas is stunned when her childhood idol, former international soccer icon Reiner Kulti, joins her team as an assistant coach. Far from the inspiring figure on her posters, Kulti is aloof, quiet, and disengaged. Through demanding training sessions and mutual competition, Sal pushes Kulti out of his isolation, building a partnership.

title: All Rhodes Lead Here
author: Mariana Zapata
description: Following a devastating long-term breakup, thirty-three-year-old Aurora De La Torre returns to the Colorado mountain town of her childhood to start over. She rents a garage apartment from Tobias Rhodes, a taciturn single father and game warden who was unaware his teenage son listed the unit. As Aurora explores the wilderness trails, she and Rhodes forge a bond rooted in emotional support.

title: Archer's Voice
author: Mia Sheridan
description: Bree Prescott arrives in the quiet town of Pelion, Maine, seeking sanctuary from a violent trauma that severed her emotional peace. She encounters Archer Hale, a mute recluse who has lived in isolation since a childhood accident left him injured and orphaned. As Bree teaches Archer sign language and breaks through his town-imposed isolation, their shared healing challenges small-town judgments.

title: Wait for You
author: J. Lynn
description: Avery Morgansten leaves her hometown to attend a West Virginia university thousands of miles away to escape the fallout of a past trauma. She crosses paths with Cameron Hamilton, an athletic classmate who refuses to let her retreat into self-imposed isolation. When anonymous threats resurface, Avery must decide whether to trust Cameron with the truth of her past.

title: Slammed
author: Colleen Hoover
description: Following the sudden death of her father, eighteen-year-old Layken moves to Ohio with her mother and younger brother to stabilize their household. She forms a connection with her neighbor Will Cooper, who introduces her to local competitive slam poetry. When an unexpected reality creates an ethical barrier to their romance, poetry becomes their primary vehicle for expression.

title: Maybe Someday
author: Colleen Hoover
description: Sydney's stable life unravels when she discovers her boyfriend and best friend have been carrying out an affair. Left with nowhere to go, she moves into an apartment with Ridge Lawson, a musician neighbor with whom she has been exchanging song lyrics. As they collaborate on music, Sydney and Ridge navigate professional respect and personal loyalties.

title: Confess
author: Colleen Hoover
description: Auburn Reed moves to Dallas determined to secure steady employment and legal custody of her son, who was taken by her late partner's family. She takes a temporary position at an art studio run by Owen Gentry, an artist who paints pieces based on anonymous public confessions. As their feelings grow, Owen struggles to conceal a past that could jeopardize Auburn's custody goals.

title: Hopeless
author: Colleen Hoover
description: Sky Davis has spent her life being homeschooled by an adoptive mother who strictly limits exposure to modern technology and outside influences. Entering public school for her senior year, she meets Dean Holder, a student with a volatile reputation who seems to recognize her from childhood. As Dean and Sky grow closer, forgotten memories resurface, revealing a shared history.

title: Without Merit
author: Colleen Hoover
description: Merit Voss lives with her eccentric, dysfunctional family in a repurposed church, feeling invisible while collecting secrets and antique trophies she never won. When she meets Sagan, an artist who challenges her to confront her avoidance, Merit's mental health and emotional strain reach a breaking point. A dramatic crisis forces the entire Voss household to confront their underlying issues.

title: All Your Perfects
author: Colleen Hoover
description: Quinn and Graham share a deep love, but years of infertility and heartbreak slowly erode the foundation of their marriage. Told across dual timelines, the narrative contrasts the bright optimism of their early romance with the quiet grief consuming their present life. To salvage their partnership, they must open a locked box of wedding vows and decide whether their commitment can weather sorrow.

title: And Then There Were None
author: Agatha Christie
description: Ten strangers, each harboring a dark secret from their past, are summoned to an opulent mansion on a secluded Devon island under mysterious pretexts. Upon arrival, their eccentric host is nowhere to be found, and a gramophone recording accuses each guest of an unpunished murder. Trapped by severe weather and cut off from the mainland, they are methodically killed one by one in accordance with an ominous nursery rhyme. As terror mounts, the survivors realize that the murderer is hiding among them.

title: The Murder of Roger Ackroyd
author: Agatha Christie
description: In the quiet English village of King's Abbot, wealthy widower Roger Ackroyd is found stabbed to death in his study shortly after receiving news that the woman he loved committed suicide. Ackroyd had just learned she was being blackmailed over the murder of her former husband, but the blackmailer's name remained unread. Renowned Belgian sleuth Hercule Poirot, having recently retired to the village to cultivate vegetable marrows, agrees to investigate. Partnering with local physician Dr. James Sheppard, Poirot pieces together a web of blackmail, greed, and deception culminating in a historic twist.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
author: Agatha Christie
description: Hercule Poirot boards the luxurious Orient Express for an urgent journey back to London, only for the train to be halted in Yugoslavia by heavy snowdrifts. During the night, an American tycoon named Samuel Ratchett is discovered stabbed twelve times inside his locked compartment. Examining the crime scene, Poirot uncovers clues linking the dead man to a notorious child kidnapping case from years earlier. With no outside footprints in the snow, Poirot must interrogate a diverse carriage of international passengers where everyone has an alibi and a motive.

title: Death on the Nile
author: Agatha Christie
description: Glamorous heiress Linnet Ridgeway embarks on a sun-drenched Egyptian honeymoon cruise aboard the steamer Karnak, accompanied by her new husband Simon Doyle. Their celebration is stalked by Simon's vindictive former fiancée Jacqueline de Bellefort, creating an atmosphere charged with jealousy and menace. When Linnet is shot in the head during the night, Hercule Poirot must sift through a passenger manifest rife with financial motives and hidden identities. As additional passengers are silenced before they can testify, Poirot races to reconstruct the sequence of events along the river.

title: The A.B.C. Murders
author: Agatha Christie
description: Hercule Poirot receives taunting letters signed 'A.B.C.', each foretelling a murder at an exact date and English location in alphabetical order. Beginning with Alice Ascher in Andover and Betty Barnard in Bexhill, a railway guide is deliberately left beside each corpse. The seemingly motiveless slaughter spreads nationwide panic as the press and police struggle to establish a connection between the victims. Poirot looks past the obvious patterns to discern whether the serial killer's apparent madness is a calculated disguise for a specific crime.

title: The Mysterious Affair at Styles
author: Agatha Christie
description: Convalescing from wartime injuries, Lieutenant Arthur Hastings accepts an invitation to stay at Styles Court, the sprawling country estate of his friend John Cavendish. Harmony is shattered when the wealthy family matriarch, Emily Inglethorp, is found writhing in agony from lethal strychnine poisoning behind locked bedroom doors. Suspicion immediately falls upon her opportunistic younger husband, her resentful stepsons, and a household full of dependents. Hastings enlists his refugee friend Hercule Poirot, marking the brilliant Belgian detective's debut investigation into misplaced wills and deceptive chemistry.

title: Crooked House
author: Agatha Christie
description: Three generations of the eccentric Leonides dynasty live together in a sprawling, asymmetrical mansion near London overseen by their wealthy Greek patriarch, Aristide. When the octogenarian is poisoned with his own eye medication, Scotland Yard discovers that anyone in the household could have swapped the insulin bottles. Charles Hayward, engaged to Aristide's granddaughter Sophia, assists in the investigation to clear her family's name so they can marry. As domestic suspicions corrode the family, Charles uncovers deep-seated malice lurking behind innocent facades.

title: A Murder Is Announced
author: Agatha Christie
description: Residents of the quaint English village of Chipping Cleghorn are startled to read a notice in the local gazette announcing that a murder will occur at Little Paddocks at 6:30 p.m. Believing it to be an eccentric party game, curious neighbors gather at the appointed hour, only for the lights to fail and real gunshots to ring out. When the illumination returns, a masked intruder lies dead and the householder is wounded. Miss Jane Marple steps forward to untangle the deceptive identities and concealed inheritances binding the villagers.

title: The Body in the Library
author: Agatha Christie
description: Colonel Arthur Bantry and his wife Dolly are horrified when their housemaid discovers the corpse of an unknown, heavily made-up blonde woman in their library at Gossington Hall. The victim is identified as Ruby Keene, an eighteen-year-old dancer at a seaside resort who was slated to inherit a fortune from a wealthy patron. Desperate to protect her husband's reputation from local scandal, Mrs. Bantry summons her friend Miss Jane Marple to unravel the puzzle. Marple uses her knowledge of human nature to deduce how two contrasting crime scenes connect.

title: Five Little Pigs
author: Agatha Christie
description: Sixteen years after Caroline Crale was convicted of poisoning her flamboyant painter husband Amyas, her daughter Carla approaches Hercule Poirot with a dying letter asserting Caroline's innocence. Poirot accepts the challenge to re-examine the long-closed case by interviewing the five other people present at the estate on the day of the murder. Dubbing the suspects the 'five little pigs', Poirot requests written accounts from each witness to spot the subtle psychological inconsistencies in their memories. Through these subjective recollections, he reconstructs the tragedy to identify the real culprit.

title: A Study in Scarlet
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Dr. John Watson, an army physician recovering from the Second Afghan War, is introduced to the eccentric consulting detective Sherlock Holmes and agrees to share rooms at 221B Baker Street. Their routine is interrupted by an investigation into an abandoned London house where an American gentleman is found dead with no visible wounds, surrounded by blood splatters and the word 'RACHE' scrawled on the wall. Holmes utilizes forensic deduction to trace the killer's movements across the city. The mystery exposes a decades-long tale of vengeance originating in the pioneer valleys of Utah.

title: The Sign of the Four
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Mary Morstan consults Sherlock Holmes regarding the mysterious disappearance of her father ten years earlier and an anonymous benefactor who has sent her a rare pearl annually ever since. When an invitation arrives requesting a nighttime meeting, Holmes and Watson accompany Miss Morstan into London's fog-laden underworld. The inquiry quickly turns deadly with the murder of an heir in a locked room and the theft of the legendary Agra treasure. Holmes and Watson embark on a river pursuit along the Thames to apprehend an escaped convict and his accomplice.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Sir Charles Baskerville is found dead on the grounds of his Devonshire estate, his face contorted in absolute terror beside the pawprints of an enormous beast. Fearing for the safety of the arriving heir, Sir Henry, Dr. Mortimer brings the ancient legend of a spectral hound haunting the family bloodline to Sherlock Holmes. Holmes dispatches Watson to Dartmoor to monitor the grim, fog-drenched moors and keep watch over Sir Henry amid escaped convicts and secretive neighbors. Working through the treacherous Grimpen Mire, Holmes uncovers a scientific plot masked by supernatural folklore.

title: The Valley of Fear
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Sherlock Holmes decodes a cipher warning that country squire John Douglas of Birlstone Manor is in mortal peril, moments before Scotland Yard confirms his gruesome murder by a sawed-off shotgun. At the moat-encircled manor, Holmes scrutinizes baffling clues including a missing wedding ring, a single bicycle footprint, and an esoteric brand on the victim's arm. The solution uncovers a covert past involving an undercover Pinkerton detective battling a criminal fraternity in an American coal mining valley. Behind the transnational vengeance, Holmes detects the hand of Professor James Moriarty.

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: This landmark collection of twelve short stories introduces many of the most famous cases in the Holmes canon as chronicled by Dr. Watson. Facing adversaries ranging from high-society blackguards to ruthless criminal conspirators, Holmes applies observation and logic to navigate Victorian London. The volume features legendary tales including 'A Scandal in Bohemia', where Irene Adler outwits the great detective, and the locked-room mystery of 'The Red-Headed League'. Each investigation showcases Holmes's forensic science and deductive method.

title: The Memoirs of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Watson records eleven classic cases highlighting the depth of Sherlock Holmes's investigative intellect, including early memories of his first recorded mystery, 'The Gloria Scott'. Holmes tracks a champion racehorse in 'Silver Blaze' and navigates familial secrets in 'The Musgrave Ritual'. The collection builds to an ideological confrontation in 'The Final Problem', introducing criminal mastermind Professor Moriarty. The narrative peaks at Switzerland's Reichenbach Falls, challenging Holmes to wager his life to neutralize an underworld empire.

title: The Return of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Three years after his presumed death at Reichenbach Falls, Sherlock Holmes reappears in London in disguise, shocking Dr. Watson in 'The Adventure of the Empty House'. Holmes reveals that he survived the encounter and spent years traveling abroad to evade Moriarty's vengeful lieutenant, Colonel Sebastian Moran. Together again at 221B Baker Street, the duo tackles thirteen complex new cases involving missing aristocrats, political espionage, and ciphered communications. The collection revitalizes the detective partnership across early Edwardian England.

title: The Big Sleep
author: Raymond Chandler
description: Los Angeles private investigator Philip Marlowe is summoned to the greenhouse of the ailing General Sternwood to handle a case of blackmail targeting his wild younger daughter, Carmen. Marlowe quickly finds that the extortion is only the surface of a criminal network involving illegal gambling, pornography rackets, and missing persons. As bodies accumulate across the rain-soaked streets of Hollywood, Marlowe navigates corrupt police officers and seductive mobsters while searching for Rusty Regan. Marlowe adheres to his personal moral code amid a compromised city.

title: Farewell, My Lovely
author: Raymond Chandler
description: While on a mundane assignment, private eye Philip Marlowe crosses paths with Moose Malloy, an imposing ex-convict searching for his former flame, Velma, who vanished during his prison sentence. Marlowe's curiosity draws him into an investigation that intertwines with the murder of a client during a jewel-theft payoff in the canyon hills. The trail leads through corrupt gambling ships, shady sanatoriums, and the bought police departments of Bay City. Marlowe faces beatings, frame-ups, and betrayal as he works to uncover Velma's true fate.

title: The Long Goodbye
author: Raymond Chandler
description: Philip Marlowe befriends Terry Lennox, a polite, scarred war veteran with a wealthy, unfaithful wife and an alcohol problem. When Lennox arrives at Marlowe's apartment in the middle of the night holding a gun and needing transportation across the Mexican border, Marlowe helps him without asking questions. Shortly after, Terry's wife is found murdered, and Marlowe is thrown into jail for refusing to betray his friend. When Lennox supposedly commits suicide in Mexico, Marlowe investigates an unstable novelist and an enigmatic blonde to find the truth.

title: The Maltese Falcon
author: Dashiell Hammett
description: San Francisco private detective Sam Spade is hired by Miss Wonderly to follow a man who supposedly ran off with her sister, but Spade's partner Miles Archer is shot dead that same night. Spade discovers his client is actually Brigid O'Shaughnessy, a cunning liar involved with international criminals hunting a jewel-encrusted statuette of a falcon gifted by the Knights of Rhodes. Spade finds himself pressured by the police for his partner's murder while bargaining with effeminate gunman Joel Cairo and syndicate boss Casper Gutman. Spade navigates greed and shifting loyalties.

title: Red Harvest
author: Dashiell Hammett
description: An unnamed operative from the Continental Detective Agency arrives in Personville, a corrupt mining town known as 'Poisonville', hired by a newspaper publisher who is murdered before they can meet. Realizing the town is run by bootleggers, corrupt cops, and rival gang factions brought in to break a strike, the Continental Op vows to clean up the city. Rather than trying to uphold traditional law enforcement, he uses psychological warfare, double-crosses, and whispered rumors to turn the criminal syndicates against each other. The resulting street warfare leaves dozens dead as corruption collapses.

title: The Thin Man
author: Dashiell Hammett
description: Former private detective Nick Charles and his wealthy socialite wife Nora are in New York City enjoying the end of Prohibition with high-society parties and cocktails. Their holiday is interrupted when Clyde Wynant, an eccentric inventor and former client of Nick's, disappears just as his secretary is found murdered. Urged by Nora, who finds the crime intriguing, Nick reluctantly agrees to consult on the case alongside the police. Operating between swanky speakeasies and gritty gangster hideouts, Nick and Nora trade witty banter while untangling Wynant's dysfunctional family.

title: The Moonstone
author: Wilkie Collins
description: Rachel Verinder inherits an enormous, priceless yellow diamond known as the Moonstone on her eighteenth birthday, unaware that it was stolen from an Indian temple and carries a curse. The following morning, the gemstone disappears from her country manor bedroom, plunging the family into turmoil and mutual suspicion. Renowned Scotland Yard investigator Sergeant Cuff arrives to examine the scene, uncovering painted door smudges and missing nightgowns. Told through multiple perspectives, the story follows Rachel's suitor Franklin Blake as he seeks to solve the theft.

title: The Woman in White
author: Wilkie Collins
description: Drawing master Walter Hartright encounters a distressed, spectral young woman dressed entirely in white on a moonlit London road, helping her find safety before learning she escaped from a private asylum. Hartright travels to Cumberland to tutor heiress Laura Fairlie, discovering she bears an uncanny physical resemblance to the woman in white, Anne Catherick. When Laura is coerced into marrying the sinister baronet Sir Percival Glyde, an elaborate plot orchestrated by the charismatic Count Fosco threatens her fortune, identity, and sanity. Walter races against time to expose an aristocratic fraud.

title: In the Woods
author: Tana French
description: Dublin Murder Squad detective Rob Ryan investigates the ritualistic killing of a twelve-year-old girl at an archaeological dig site in the suburban town of Knocknaree. The crime scene takes place in the same woods where Ryan himself was found traumatized twenty years earlier, his childhood friends having disappeared without a trace. Partnering with detective Cassie Maddox, Ryan attempts to conceal his personal connection to the forest from the department while hunting a modern predator. As the pressure mounts, Ryan's psychological trauma threatens to derail both cases.

title: The Likeness
author: Tana French
description: Detective Cassie Maddox is summoned to a murder scene in a rural cottage outside Dublin, where the dead university student looks identical to Cassie and carries an alias Cassie used during an undercover operation. Cassie's former supervisor devises a covert plan: withhold news of the victim's death and have Cassie impersonate her, claiming the stab wound was non-fatal. Infiltrating the victim's close-knit circle of eccentric doctoral students in a crumbling Georgian manor, Cassie searches for the killer from within. The assignment blurs the line between her true identity and the life she inhabits.

title: Faithful Place
author: Tana French
description: Undercover detective Frank Mackey severed ties with his abusive inner-city Dublin family nineteen years ago when his teenage sweetheart, Rosie Daly, seemingly stood him up for a planned elopement to London. When Rosie's packed suitcase is discovered tucked behind a fireplace in an abandoned tenement on Faithful Place, Frank realizes she never left the neighborhood alive. Returning to the working-class streets he escaped, Frank conducts an unauthorized investigation that pits him against his dysfunctional siblings and suspicious neighbors. Unearthing old secrets, Frank confronts the costs of family loyalty.

title: Broken Harbor
author: Tana French
description: Meticulous veteran detective Mick 'Scorcher' Kennedy is assigned to a high-profile homicide in Brianstown, a half-abandoned housing development built on the coastal outskirts of Dublin. A father and two young children are found dead inside their home, while the severely injured mother clings to life in intensive care. What initially looks like a domestic breakdown driven by the economic crash reveals unsettling details, including holes smashed through the drywall and baby monitors pointed into the attic. Kennedy confronts his own buried childhood trauma while investigating the family's final days.

title: The Secret Place
author: Tana French
description: One year after the unsolved murder of handsome private school student Chris Harper on the grounds of St. Kilda's boarding school, a notice is pinned to the school's anonymous bulletin board stating 'I know who killed him'. Detective Stephen Moran seizes on the card as his ticket to join the Murder Squad, teaming up with abrasive lead detective Antoinette Conway. Over the course of a single day, the detectives interrogate two rival cliques of teenage girls whose intense loyalties mask dangerous secrets. Moran and Conway navigate social hierarchies to find the killer.

title: The Trespasser
author: Tana French
description: Detective Antoinette Conway faces isolation and harassment from her colleagues in the Dublin Murder Squad, making her suspicious of every case assigned to her and her partner Stephen Moran. When they are dispatched to the murder of Aislinn Murray, a polished blonde woman found dead at her dining table, the squad pressures them to treat it as an open-and-shut domestic crime. Convinced there is more to the killing than an aggressive date, Conway pushes deeper into the victim's guarded personal life. As internal politics escalate, Conway battles departmental sabotage to find the truth.

title: The Searcher
author: Tana French
description: Cal Hooper, a burned-out former Chicago police officer reeling from a difficult divorce, buys a derelict cottage in an isolated village in the west of Ireland seeking peace and solitude. His quiet retirement is interrupted when a local teenager named Trey secretly approaches him, asking for help in finding an older brother who vanished without explanation. Despite his reluctance to get involved in local affairs, Cal begins asking cautious questions around the village pub and farming community. He discovers that the close-knit community conceals deep secrets beneath its neighborly exterior.

title: One of Us Is Lying
author: Karen M. McManus
description: Five students at Bayview High—the brain, the beauty, the criminal, the athlete, and the outcast—walk into afternoon detention, but only four walk out alive. Simon Kelleher, the creator of the school's notorious gossip app that publicly ruins students' lives, suffers a fatal allergic reaction from a cup laced with peanut oil. Investigators discover that Simon was hours away from publishing career-ending secrets about each of the four surviving classmates, making them all prime murder suspects. The teenagers form an uneasy alliance to prove their innocence before the killer strikes again.

title: One of Us Is Next
author: Karen M. McManus
description: Eighteen months after the death of Simon Kelleher, a new anonymous tormentor targets the student body of Bayview High with a lethal game of Truth or Dare via mass text messaging. Choosing Truth exposes devastating personal secrets, while choosing Dare leads to dangerous stunts that turn deadly when a teenager falls from a construction site. Maeve, Knox, and Phoebe band together to trace the digital footprint of the game's creator before their own secrets are weaponized. The investigation uncovers buried connections linking the modern game to Simon's legacy.

title: Two Can Keep a Secret
author: Karen M. McManus
description: Twins Ellery and Ezra move to the small Vermont town of Echo Ridge to live with their grandmother after their mother enters rehab. The picturesque mountain town is haunted by unresolved history: the twins' teenage aunt vanished without a trace seventeen years earlier, and a popular homecoming queen was murdered five years ago. Just as the school year begins, anonymous threats spray-painted across town declare that homecoming is open season once more, culminating in another girl's disappearance. Ellery uses her true-crime obsession to uncover the town's buried history.

title: The Cousins
author: Karen M. McManus
description: Milly, Aubrey, and Jonah Story are first cousins who barely know each other, their parents having been disinherited twenty-four years earlier by their wealthy grandmother Mildred with a single cryptic letter: 'You know what you did'. When the reclusive matriarch unexpectedly invites the three teenagers to work at her private island resort for the summer, their parents urge them to go and make amends. Arriving on Gull Cove Island, the cousins realize their grandmother is evasive, cold, and harboring secrets about the day she severed family ties. They unravel the decades-old scandal behind their family's wealth.

title: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder
author: Holly Jackson
description: Five years ago, popular schoolgirl Andie Bell was murdered in the quiet town of Little Kilton, and her boyfriend Sal Singh committed suicide after seemingly confessing to the crime. High school senior Pippa Fitz-Amobi chooses the closed case as the topic for her final-year project, convinced that Sal was falsely accused and the real killer went free. Enlisting Sal's younger brother Ravi as her partner, Pip uncovers drug rings, secret affairs, and hidden diaries that local authorities ignored. As she approaches the truth, threatening messages make it clear that the real killer is willing to silence her.

title: Good Girl, Bad Blood
author: Holly Jackson
description: Following her viral true-crime podcast on the Andie Bell investigation, Pip Fitz-Amobi resolves to retire from detective work to protect her safety and mental health. Her vow is tested when Jamie Reynolds, the older brother of her close friend Connor, disappears on the night of a town memorial service and the police refuse to treat him as a missing person. Pip launches a real-time investigative podcast to crowdsource clues, tracking Jamie's digital activity, secret phone numbers, and mysterious acquaintances. The search forces Pip to confront the growing moral compromises of vigilante justice.

title: As Good as Dead
author: Holly Jackson
description: Struggling with severe post-traumatic stress and online harassment from her past investigations, Pip Fitz-Amobi prepares to leave for college at Cambridge. Her anxiety escalates when she notices subtle signs that she is being actively stalked: headless chalk figures drawn on her driveway, dead birds left in her garden, and repeated online threats asking 'Who will look for you when you disappear?'. Connecting her stalker's methods to a serial killer imprisoned years ago, Pip realizes the police arrested the wrong suspect. To survive, Pip is pushed into a high-stakes psychological game where legal boundaries vanish.

title: Five Survive
author: Holly Jackson
description: Six high school friends embark on an eight-hour spring break road trip to the Gulf Coast aboard an aging, thirty-one-foot recreational vehicle. When they take an ill-advised detour through an isolated mountain area, their tires are blown out by specialized puncture traps, leaving them stranded without cellular reception. A hidden sniper equipped with night-vision scopes targets the RV, communicating via a walkie-talkie that one of the passengers holds a secret he wants exposed. Trapped inside the vehicle as hours tick down, the friends turn on each other to survive.

title: The Thursday Murder Club
author: Richard Osman
description: In the peaceful retirement village of Coopers Chase, four octogenarians—former intelligence operative Elizabeth, ex-nurse Joyce, union activist Ron, and psychiatrist Ibrahim—meet weekly to review unsolved cold cases. Their hobby turns practical when a local property developer is bludgeoned to death in his home, leaving a photograph placed on the body. Teaming up with ambitious policewoman Donna De Freitas and DCI Chris Hudson, the club uses their overlooked senior status to interview suspects and bypass red tape. The investigation uncovers decades of mob ties and greed.

title: The Man Who Died Twice
author: Richard Osman
description: Elizabeth receives an unexpected letter from her former MI5 husband Marcus, who has been placed in protective custody after being accused of stealing twenty million pounds' worth of diamonds from a ruthless cartel courier. When Marcus is executed alongside his protective handler, Elizabeth enlists her retirement companions Joyce, Ron, and Ibrahim to solve the murder and track down the missing jewels. The seniors find themselves dealing with British intelligence, local drug syndicates, and street thugs. Combining tradecraft with afternoon tea, the group works to outmaneuver international assassins.

title: The Bullet That Missed
author: Richard Osman
description: The Thursday Murder Club dives into a ten-year-old cold case involving a local television news journalist whose car tumbled over a cliff with no body ever recovered. Meanwhile, a former KGB operative pressures Elizabeth to murder an old intelligence contact or face lethal consequences for herself and her friends. Juggling the television cold case alongside an active assassination threat, the group travels from high-security prisons to corporate television studios. Their investigation reveals financial fraud, cyber-espionage, and cold war secrets.

title: The Last Devil to Die
author: Richard Osman
description: The retirement sleuths are devastated when their close friend, an antiques dealer named Kuldish Sharma, is murdered and his body burned inside his vehicle in the countryside. They discover Kuldish was unwittingly storing an illicit shipment of heroin that has gone missing, drawing the attention of dangerous cartels and corrupt dealers. Navigating grief, cognitive decline, and aging, the seniors work to recover the contraband before more lives are lost. Elizabeth, Joyce, Ron, and Ibrahim demonstrate their loyalty, cunning, and humor against violent adversaries.

title: Truly Devious
author: Maureen Johnson
description: Stevie Bell is an introverted true-crime enthusiast who wins admission to Ellingham Academy, a prestigious private boarding school founded in Vermont by an eccentric tycoon. Stevie arrives determined to crack the school's cold case: the 1936 kidnapping of the founder's wife and daughter, marked by a mocking riddle signed 'Truly, Devious'. Shortly after classes begin, the past resurfaces when a modern student is found dead under suspicious circumstances. Stevie must navigate academic rivalries and the historical layout of the campus to uncover the truth.

title: The Vanishing Stair
author: Maureen Johnson
description: Pulled from Ellingham Academy by her parents following the death of a classmate, Stevie Bell makes a secret deal with a political candidate to secure her return to campus. Back in Vermont, Stevie balances the demands of schoolwork with her dual investigation into the modern campus murders and the 1930s kidnapping. Sifting through historic letters and secret tunnels, Stevie uncovers clues left behind by the academy's original staff. Each revelation exposes how the Ellingham legacy continues to claim lives in the present day.

title: The Hand on the Wall
author: Maureen Johnson
description: As a severe winter blizzard isolates Ellingham Academy from the outside world, emergency protocols are triggered and the campus is ordered to evacuate. Refusing to abandon her pursuit of justice, Stevie Bell remains behind with a small group of students as power fails across the grounds. Armed with key artifacts and decoded messages, Stevie races to unmask the true identity of 'Truly Devious' and catch the modern murderer. The trilogy reaches its climax as buried family secrets and hidden chambers are exposed.

title: The Maid
author: Nita Prose
description: Molly Gray is a socially awkward, neurodivergent hotel maid who takes pride in her work at the Grand Regency Hotel, restoring guest suites to perfection. Her orderly world is shattered when she enters the penthouse and discovers the corpse of infamous, wealthy real estate magnate Charles Black. Because of her unusual demeanor and literal responses, the police quickly focus on Molly as the prime suspect in an international money-laundering conspiracy. Aided by friends from the hotel staff, Molly must assemble the clues to clear her name.

title: The Mystery Guest
author: Nita Prose
description: Having risen to the position of Head Maid at the Grand Regency Hotel, Molly the Maid is supervising a high-profile literary gathering in the hotel tearoom. The event ends in chaos when celebrated mystery author J.D. Grimthorpe drops dead on stage, clutching his throat from lethal poison. As the police treat the tearoom as a crime scene, Molly realizes she holds private memories of Grimthorpe from her childhood, when her grandmother worked at his private mansion. Molly must revisit past secrets to identify the murderer among the gathered guests.

title: Magpie Murders
author: Anthony Horowitz
description: London book editor Susan Ryeland is handed the unfinished manuscript of bestselling mystery author Alan Conway's latest Atticus Pünd detective novel. As Susan reads the 1950s English village whodunit, she discovers that the crucial final chapter resolving the murder is missing. The mystery deepens when Conway is found dead at his estate, ruled a suicide by police despite contradictory physical clues. Susan conducts her own investigation, realizing that the characters and plotlines in Conway's novel conceal real-world blackmail and murder.

title: Moonflower Murders
author: Anthony Horowitz
description: Susan Ryeland is managing a struggling boutique hotel in Crete when an English couple arrives with an unusual proposition regarding their missing daughter, Cecily. Years earlier, a murder occurred at the couple's Suffolk hotel, a crime that inspired late author Alan Conway to write one of his Atticus Pünd novels. Shortly before vanishing, Cecily claimed to have read Conway's book and discovered proof that an innocent man was convicted of the killing. Susan returns to England to dissect Conway's text line by line and locate Cecily.

title: The Word Is Murder
author: Anthony Horowitz
description: A fictionalized version of author Anthony Horowitz is approached by Daniel Hawthorne, an eccentric, disgraced former Scotland Yard detective who needs a biographer. Hawthorne is investigating the bizarre death of Diana Cowper, a wealthy woman who was strangled in her home six hours after walking into a London funeral parlor to plan her service. Reluctantly agreeing to shadow Hawthorne, Horowitz finds himself out of his depth as a real-life Watson to a brilliant, secretive partner. Horowitz must navigate genuine police procedures while trying to decipher Hawthorne's guarded past.

title: The Sentence Is Death
author: Anthony Horowitz
description: Private investigator Daniel Hawthorne recruits author Anthony Horowitz once again to document an investigation into the murder of Richard Pryce, a prominent celebrity divorce lawyer. Pryce is bludgeoned to death in his London home with a bottle of vintage wine, leaving the cryptic number '182' painted on his wall in green paint. The case centers on an eccentric poet who previously threatened Pryce, alongside a tragic caving accident that occurred years ago in Yorkshire. Horowitz struggles to keep pace with Hawthorne's deductions while trying to learn the truth about his partner.

title: A Line to Kill
author: Anthony Horowitz
description: Daniel Hawthorne and Anthony Horowitz are invited to a literary festival on the island of Alderney to promote their true-crime collaboration alongside a group of authors. The gathering takes a dark turn when a wealthy local benefactor backing a controversial power cable project is found murdered, taped to a chair with his throat cut. Cut off from mainland police by shifting tides and fog, Hawthorne and Horowitz take charge of the investigation among the eccentric authors and residents. The case exposes island corruption, military history, and competitive rivalries.

title: The Cuckoo's Calling
author: Robert Galbraith
description: Struggling war veteran Cormoran Strike operates a threadbare private detective agency in central London, down on his luck and sleeping in his office. He is hired by John Bristow to look into the death of his adopted sister, supermodel Lula Landry, whose fatal plunge from her Mayfair balcony was ruled a suicide by police. Aided by his newly hired temp secretary Robin Ellacott, Strike enters the high-fashion world of rock stars, designers, and paparazzi. Strike's interrogation of the social elite exposes exploitation beneath glamour.

title: The Silkworm
author: Robert Galbraith
description: Private detective Cormoran Strike is hired by the wife of eccentric novelist Owen Quine, who has disappeared following a dispute with his publishing house.
